title: Career Strategy Session — How to Land Big Tech Offers
summary_brief: Haoyu Wang and Xiaowen Mai, colleagues at the same company, discussed actionable strategies for landing offers at top-tier tech companies. They covered resume optimization with quantified impact metrics, a structured LeetCode preparation plan, system design interview techniques, behavioral question frameworks, and leveraging internal referrals and networking effectively.

actions.task: Complete 150 LeetCode problems covering core patterns (sliding window, dynamic programming, graph traversal) within the next 8 weeks.
actions.description_plain: Follow a structured LeetCode study plan focusing on high-frequency patterns to build consistent problem-solving speed.

actions.task: Revise resume to follow the XYZ format with quantified impact metrics, and reach out to at least 3 internal referrals at target companies.
actions.description_plain: Rewrite resume bullet points using the Accomplished X by doing Y which resulted in Z format, and activate referral network.
